THE   GAZETTE   OF  INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY 

[PART III—SEC. 4] 

# **INSURANCE REGULATORY AND DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF INDIA** 

# **NOTIFICATION** 

Hyderabad, the 20<sup>th</sup> February, 2018 

# **INSURANCE REGULATORY AND DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF INDIA** 

# **(STANDARD PROPOSAL FORM FOR LIFE INSURANCE) (REPEAL)** 

# **REGULATIONS, 2018** 

**F. No. IRDAI/Reg/3/150/2018.—** In exercise of the powers conferred by clause (zc) and (zd) of sub section (2) of Section 114A of Insurance Act, 1938 (4 of 1938) and Sections 14 and 26 of the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority Act, 1999, the Authority, in consultation with the Insurance Advisory Committee, hereby repeals the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority (Standard Proposal Form for Life Insurance) Regulations, 2013 with effect from the date of publication in the Official Gazette. 

<mark>T.S. VIJAYAN, Chairman [ ADVT. III/4/Exty./456/17]</mark>
